blocks.summary: Sets the brightness of the pen color. 0 is black and 100 is the brightest color.

params.name: value
params.description: The new brightness, from 0 to 100.

blocks.summary: Sets the transparency of the pen color. 0 is not transparent, higher values make the lines more see-through.

params.name: value
params.description: The new transparency, from 0 to 100.

blocks.summary: Changes the thickness of the pen by the given amount. The pen is at least 1 thick.

params.name: value
params.description: The change of the pen thickness. Negative values make the pen thinner.

blocks.summary: Sets the thickness of the pen. The pen is at least 1 thick.

params.name: value
params.description: The new pen thickness.

blocks.summary: Loads a sound file, so that the sprite or stage can play it.
more: Sounds are also loaded automatically when they are played for the first time.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the sound file, e.g. "pop.wav". The file must be in the project folder.

blocks.summary: Sets the name of the sprite. Other blocks can refer to the sprite by this name.

params.name: name
params.description: The new name of the sprite.

blocks.summary: Adds a new sprite to the stage and returns it. The sprite is shown with the given costume.
more: The name of the sprite is "Sprite" for the default costume, otherwise the name of the costume.

params.name: costume
params.description: The name of the image file for the sprite's costume, e.g. "cat.png". "default" is the standard costume of pystage.

blocks.summary: Creates a new variable. The variable can be used with the variable blocks and shown as a monitor.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the variable. It must not exist yet.

params.name: value
params.description: The initial value of the variable. The default is 0.

params.name: all_sprites
params.description: If True, the variable is shared by the stage and all sprites. If False, it belongs to this sprite only.

blocks.summary: Create a list.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the list.

params.name: values
params.description: The initial items of the list.

params.name: all_sprites
params.description: If True, the list can be used by the stage and all sprites. If False, it belongs to this sprite only.

blocks.summary: Sets the position of the monitor of a variable on the stage.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the variable.

params.name: x
params.description: The horizontal position of the upper left corner of the monitor. The center of the stage is 0.

params.name: y
params.description: The vertical position of the upper left corner of the monitor. The center of the stage is 0.

blocks.summary: Set position and size of the list shown on the stage.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the list.

params.name: x
params.description: Left border.

params.name: y
params.description: Upper border.

params.name: width
params.description: Width in pixels, automatic if not given.

params.name: height
params.description: Height in pixels, automatic if not given.

blocks.summary: Shows the monitor of a variable in the large style, with a big display of its value.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the variable.

blocks.summary: Adds a costume (an image) to the sprite. The costume is added at the end of the costume list.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the image file, e.g. "cat.png". The file must be in the project folder.

params.name: center_x
params.description: The horizontal position of the costume's center in the image, in pixels. If not given, the center of the image is used.

params.name: center_y
params.description: The vertical position of the costume's center in the image, in pixels. If not given, the center of the image is used.

params.name: factor
params.description: The scaling of the image. 1 keeps the original size, 2 shows it at double size.

blocks.summary: Shows the monitor of a variable in the normal style, with a small display of its value.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the variable.

blocks.summary: Replaces an existing costume of the sprite with another image.

params.name: index
params.description: The number of the costume to replace, starting with 1.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the new image file.

params.name: center_x
params.description: The horizontal position of the costume's center in the image, in pixels. If not given, the center of the image is used.

params.name: center_y
params.description: The vertical position of the costume's center in the image, in pixels. If not given, the center of the image is used.

params.name: factor
params.description: The scaling of the image. 1 keeps the original size.

blocks.summary: Shows the variable as a slider that can be dragged with the mouse.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the variable.

params.name: minimum
params.description: The lowest value of the slider. Like in Scratch, the default is 0.

params.name: maximum
params.description: The highest value of the slider. Like in Scratch, the default is 100.

params.name: integer
params.description: If True, the slider only sets whole numbers, otherwise numbers with two decimals.

blocks.summary: Inserts a costume (an image) into the sprite's costume list at the given position.

params.name: index
params.description: The position where the costume is inserted, starting with 1.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the image file, e.g. "cat.png".

params.name: center_x
params.description: The horizontal position of the costume's center in the image, in pixels. If not given, the center of the image is used.

params.name: center_y
params.description: The vertical position of the costume's center in the image, in pixels. If not given, the center of the image is used.

params.name: factor
params.description: The scaling of the image. 1 keeps the original size.

blocks.summary: Show the monitor of a value, like the checkbox next to a block in Scratch.

params.name: reporter
params.description: What to show: "x position", "y position", "direction", "costume number", "costume name", "size", "volume" (sprites and stage), "backdrop number", "backdrop name" (stage), "answer", "loudness", "timer", "year", "month", "date", "day of week", "hour", "minute", "second" or "username".

blocks.summary: Hides the monitor of a value.

params.name: reporter
params.description: The value, e.g. "x position", "size", "timer" or "year". The same values as for show_monitor are allowed.

blocks.summary: Set the position of the monitor of a value.

params.name: reporter
params.description: The value, see show_monitor.

params.name: x
params.description: Left border (Scratch coordinates).

params.name: y
params.description: Upper border (Scratch coordinates).

blocks.summary: Set the style of the monitor of a value.

params.name: reporter
params.description: The value, see show_monitor.

params.name: style
params.description: "normal" or "large".

blocks.summary: Adds a backdrop (an image) to the stage. The backdrop is added at the end of the backdrop list.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the image file, e.g. "forest.png". The file must be in the project folder.

params.name: center_x
params.description: The horizontal position of the image's center, in pixels. If not given, the center of the image is used.

params.name: center_y
params.description: The vertical position of the image's center, in pixels. If not given, the center of the image is used.

params.name: factor
params.description: The scaling of the image. 1 keeps the original size.

blocks.summary: Starts the program. The stage is shown and all scripts run until the window is closed.
more: Call this once, at the end of the program.

blocks.summary: Replaces an existing backdrop of the stage with another image.

params.name: index
params.description: The number of the backdrop to replace, starting with 1.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the new image file.

params.name: center_x
params.description: The horizontal position of the image's center, in pixels. If not given, the center of the image is used.

params.name: center_y
params.description: The vertical position of the image's center, in pixels. If not given, the center of the image is used.

params.name: factor
params.description: The scaling of the image. 1 keeps the original size.

blocks.summary: Inserts a backdrop (an image) into the stage's backdrop list at the given position.

params.name: index
params.description: The position where the backdrop is inserted, starting with 1.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the image file, e.g. "forest.png".

params.name: center_x
params.description: The horizontal position of the image's center, in pixels. If not given, the center of the image is used.

params.name: center_y
params.description: The vertical position of the image's center, in pixels. If not given, the center of the image is used.

params.name: factor
